Fix in both handlers' `gatherUsedTypeNames` (which picks non-clashing names for the generated `<C, B>` type variables) — it now also collects names from the `extends` and `implements` clauses:
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1127` — adds the superclass name and first tokens of the implements-clause types (new `addFirstTypeNameToken` helper).
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1109` — same via `td.superclass` / `td.superInterfaces`.

For `ExtendsClauseCollision extends B implements B2.B4<Object>, B3<Object>` the type variable now resolves as `B`→`B2`→`B3`→`B4`, matching the expected output in the existing `SuperBuilderNameClashes` test.
